messages:
kevin: Consolidating postmortem follow-ups from last DR game day. I'll list owners + proposed timelines. Please ack and update if dates don't work. Short context: routing fallback triggered a partial traffic split, some backups were unverified for a subset of clusters, and a few manual steps in the restore runbook caused delays.

jess: taking A1 (multi-region routing policy). I'll look at BGP/route-map + health-check timeouts. ETA 2026-04-08. Will open an RFC.

tom: taking A2 (snapshot verification). I'll add a nightly verify job and a quick restore smoke test. ETA 2026-03-30. PR: https://git.redwood/internal/ops/backup-verify/pulls/42

sara: taking A3 (restore runbook gaps). I'll update the runbook with KMS rotation and VIP rebind steps. Adding the exact command snippets now:
```
# restore snapshot to test cluster
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-backups/2026-03-21/cluster-snap.tar.gz /tmp/
./restore.sh --cluster test-restore --kms-key alias/redwood-restore
```
ETA 2026-04-01

carla: A5 dashboard + recurring pattern tracking — will wire up a Datadog dashboard, add tags for region/failure-type and a weekly alert. ETA 2026-04-15

ben: A6 (automated fallback verification). I'll add a smoke-test step to the canary pipeline that runs post-failover and validates routing + service health. ETA 2026-03-28

kevin: I'll coordinate game-day drill cadence: weekly table-top for 4 weeks, then monthly. First drill 2026-04-06 (09:00 UTC). Also want to run a warm-standby failover drill for eu-west on 2026-04-20.

oncall-bot: reminder set for 2026-04-06 09:00 UTC -> #incidents (assigned: kevin)

deploy-bot: infra-priority label added to PR 42

jess: quick note — I suspect the root cause is health-check timeout + aggressive route withdrawal. Adding an integration test around healthcheck thresholds.

sara: will add a "pre-restore checklist" to the runbook so oncall confirms snapshots + key access before starting

tom: can we pair on the verify job? I want to make sure restore doesn't hit rate limits. @sara?

sara: yep, happy to pair. booking 30m slot tomorrow

kevin: action tracker (short):
- A1 multi-region routing: owner=jess, ETA=2026-04-08, ticket=OPS-3123
- A2 backup verify job: owner=tom, ETA=2026-03-30, PR=42
- A3 runbook gaps: owner=sara, ETA=2026-04-01, doc=https://redwood.internal/runbooks/restore
- A5 pattern dashboard: owner=carla, ETA=2026-04-15
- A6 fallback smoke tests: owner=ben, ETA=2026-03-28

kevin: tagging owners — please update status here as you make progress. I'll convert to a shared spreadsheet after initial updates so PMs can track.

jess: ack :thumbsup:

tom: ack

sara: ack

carla: ack

ben: ack

kevin: closing thread — I'll post a weekly update on Mondays until all items closed.
